title: IBM Managed Technical Support Services
description: Simplify support for multi-vendor environments, with comprehensive and integrated Managed Technical Support Services

asr.full_text: Hello, I'm Ken Haines, the Portfolio Executive for Managed Technical Support Services for IBM. Managed Technical Support Services is designed to address three primary areas. Cost reduction. Of support, simplification of support, and improved service. Just as there is total cost. Of ownership, or TCO, there is TCOS, or total cost of support. Today, clients just like you. Are seeking significant savings in their TCOS and how they support their entire IT environment. Clients want to reduce expense and focus expense savings on funding priority projects that. Will grow their business. And clients want to simplify and manage the growing complexity of IT support. Over the years, many things have become simpler, but IT support isn't one of those things,. And there are no signs of this changing. And here's why. There continues to be growing diversity in systems, platforms, hardware, software, and. Networking, not to mention the growing complexity brought on by virtualization. And cloud-based solutions. Plus, many clients want to improve availability and. Service to their clients. Businesses continue to place ever-increasing. Expectations on IT, so there's strong need and demand for IT high availability. There's also demand for quality support services that help clients manage and. Minimize risk, and it's not just the risk of hardware malfunction anymore, but of. Entire business functions and processes. Managed Technical Support Services. Addresses cost reduction of support, simplification of support, improved. Service, and much more. Managed Technical Support Services is where IBM takes what. Many IT analysts call a lead service provider role with the client. Rather. Than the client trying to support everything internally or trying to self. Coordinate support of the environment with a number of different vendors, IBM. Can be that single point of accountability or that lead service. Provider for all support needs managing and coordinating support on all IBM and. Non-IBM systems the whole environment at IBM we can provide things like delivery. Management inventory management change management availability management we. Can provide clients ongoing analytics on their IT and support infrastructure we. Have electronic links to the clients help desk and we can manage clients. Warranties. We can manage various vendors and we have a whole ecosystem of. Partners we can bring to the support solution. There's even transition. Management if needed. Managed technical support services looks beyond a client's. Need for just break-fix solutions. For example, through component business. Modeling we can assist in optimizing and designing how a client operates its call. Centers and help desk and how the client performs moves, adds and changes as well. As call placement methodology, we can drive support efficiencies, optimize call flow,. Standardize service levels, and deliver a solution that's consistent across the entire. Enterprise. Managed Technical Support Services can reduce operational costs anywhere from 5 to 40% and. Increase availability anywhere from 5 to 10%. Managed Technical Support Services allows clients to have consistent service levels. Across a complex multi-vendor environment and approaches problem coordination, resolution,. Management in a holistic, integrated way, while at the same time allowing clients to. Focus their resources on growth and priority initiatives. To help you understand where you may have gaps in your IT support and areas for potential. Improvement, we developed an informal online assessment tool that allows you to compare. Your current existing support to your desired state. You might also consider a managed technical support workshop to help formally assess and. Quantify the benefits of a managed technical support services solution. If this interests you, simply contact your IBM representative or visit ibm.com forward. Slash services forward slash maintenance for more information. Thanks for taking time to view this video.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents IBM Managed Technical Support Services as a conventional business-to-business offering focused on coordinating and improving enterprise IT support. Its workshop and service-management material, along with a direction to contact IBM for more information, are consistent with that ordinary commercial context rather than showing an investment, credential, payment, or other deceptive participation mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an ordinary business service offering: IBM describes managed technical support, coordination across enterprise systems, and a related workshop, then provides a contact route for more information.
